import numpy as np
from itertools import product

sample_space = list(product(range(1, 7), range(1, 7)))

total_outcomes = len(sample_space)

event_A = [outcome for outcome in sample_space if sum(outcome) == 7]
prob_A = len(event_A) / total_outcomes

event_B = [outcome for outcome in sample_space if outcome[0] == outcome[1]]
prob_B = len(event_B) / total_outcomes

event_C = [outcome for outcome in sample_space if sum(outcome) > 9]
prob_C = len(event_C) / total_outcomes

intersection_AB = [outcome for outcome in sample_space if outcome in event_A and outcome in event_B]
prob_AB = len(intersection_AB) / total_outcomes

union_AB = [outcome for outcome in sample_space if outcome in event_A or outcome in event_B]
prob_A_or_B = len(union_AB) / total_outcomes

inclusion_exclusion = prob_A + prob_B - prob_AB

print(f"Sample space size: {total_outcomes}")
print(f"P(sum=7) = {prob_A:.4f}")
print(f"P(doubles) = {prob_B:.4f}")
print(f"P(sum>9) = {prob_C:.4f}")
print(f"P(A and B) = {prob_AB:.4f}")
print(f"P(A or B) = {prob_A_or_B:.4f}")
print(f"Inclusion-exclusion check: {inclusion_exclusion:.4f}")
